colophon.text: C|24's requirements called for an external power supply and prohibited a fan at the listening position. Moving power conversion outside the console helped make the lower-profile enclosure possible.
colophon.title: Start with the product constraint

method.text: I worked with Mass Precision on manual offset-welded C|24 panels and supported the overseas fabrication path while welding capability and panel quality were resolved. Tool access and cosmetic quality belonged in the same manufacturing decision.
method.title: Design for the supplier's process

method.title: Define what the factory should accept

method.title: Carry the control into the assembly

case-study.text: Tracked Glyph telescope-arm tests by dated specimen cohort. In the March 16 T6 cohort, specimens 49 and 50 of the five tested could not return at 250 cycles. These are dated specimen results, not a production failure rate or a sequence of tooling revisions. The reports contain conflicting summary and comment fields. Later cable concepts reused the T labels and cannot inherit these passes.
case-study.title: Keep failures with their test cohort

case-study.text: Compared SC48 4U configurations with three 80 mm fans at 8.5 V and 12 V: left R69 rise differed by 9.9°C and absolute temperature by 11.6°C, with differing ambient conditions. This does not isolate voltage as the cause of the full change. The 75°C log entry is an observed shutdown, not an established BIOS threshold or a basis for claiming safety margin.
case-study.title: Compare complete cooling configurations
